inclusions.text: Private charter boat for your party alone
inclusions.source: This is a private charter, operated for your party alone — one group, one boat, one dedicated guide — built around either the Strait of Tiran or Ras Mohamed National Park, depending on conditions and preference.

inclusions.text: Private, air-conditioned hotel transfer to the marina
inclusions.source: A private, air-conditioned vehicle collects you from your hotel in Sharm El Sheikh and transfers you to the marina, where your boat and crew are already prepared.
The transfer back to your hotel departs from the marina on arrival.
